deities.name: Sigrananna
deities.rationale: Forest ancestry, long life, grace, and woodland stewardship place the Lumhishūhito most closely under the Moonlit Huntress.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Hathruna
deities.rationale: Their stored seasonal light and view of habitat as inherited memory align with seasonal return, roots, and renewal.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Sokhivar
deities.rationale: Sunlight held within the body and canopy-centered communities connect them to sacred light and the open sky.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
